authorityReview.evidence: Human review of the pinned official implementation/interface/USDC role records. The interface declares supplyFrom(address,address,address,uint256) as nonpayable with no outputs. Implementation lines 729–731 pass the external caller and caller-selected from, dst, asset, and amount to supplyInternal; lines 737–749 enforce protocol pause, hasPermission(from,msg.sender), and fixed base-asset-or-collateral handling. Comet delegation may be required; platform admission neither creates delegation nor adds a platform from/self constraint. This records the ordinary selector/ABI only, not runtime identity or financial safety.
